# Comfy ElevenLabs- Text to Sound Effects

Input a text prompt to generate custom sound effects and ambient audio. Runs on Comfy Cloud and needs Comfy Cloud partner credits.

**How it works:** The Comfy nodes form the complete template graph. Run submits the graph to Comfy Cloud and saves its outputs.

**Try this:** Change the prompt or the Load node inputs and run again to compare results.

Source: https://github.com/Comfy-Org/workflow_templates/blob/1ae390968e323dba24a6991d1860ded051f5a79b/templates/api_elevenlabs_text_to_sound_effects.json (MIT). Model licenses apply separately.

data.text: Traffic noise with honking horns, busy highway
